additional_info.subject: ID0430410-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002000] Charger has voltage issue CRM:00798002240
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
We could see voltage issue due to non-engagement of the 2 converters.
And converters belong to DC1 and DC4 section, Hence, Resultant Power you can see on Outlet 1 and Outlet 4.
We could see that the Couple of Converters have fast shutdown issue.
We have highlighted the Serial number of converters with issue.
We need to check the Fast shutdown line. (As highlighted in the below image)
We recommend having spare FA10 while site intervention.
In dispenser side,
We need to check for the following connections to be tidy as per schematics.
We recommend having spare KF214 while site intervention.
